metadata.standard_reference: ISLRTC / DEPwD, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India

signs.movement_sequence: Gentle wave motion outward from temple
signs.right_hand_sequence: Raise to temple level, oscillate wrist horizontally 15 degrees

signs.hand_configuration: Both hands flat open palms pressed together (Anjali Mudra)
signs.movement_sequence: Bring both hands from sides to meet at chest with slight forward bowing
signs.left_hand_sequence: Mirror right hand, press palms together
signs.right_hand_sequence: Move to chest center, press palms together

regional_variant.North: Palms pressed at center chest with head nod
regional_variant.West: Single hand touch chest then slight forward wave
regional_variant.South: Palms pressed higher near chin level

signs.hand_configuration: Flat hand with fingers touching chin, then moving forward
signs.hand_orientation: Palm facing inward at start, facing forward/upward at end
signs.movement_sequence: Fingertips touch chin lightly then project forward toward recipient
signs.right_hand_sequence: Chin contact, forward trajectory 25cm downward angle
signs.head_movement: Slight downward nod synchronized with hand release

regional_variant.North: Hand from chin moving outward at 45 degrees
regional_variant.West: Flat hand touches chest then arches forward
regional_variant.South: Both hands cupped slightly moving forward
regional_variant.East: Right hand touches cheek and lowers

signs.hand_configuration: Both hands flat open, cupped gently
signs.hand_orientation: Palms facing upward and slightly inward
signs.movement_sequence: Both hands sweep inward from sides toward chest invitingly
signs.left_hand_sequence: Sweep from outer left inward toward body center
signs.right_hand_sequence: Sweep from outer right inward toward body center

signs.meaning: Inquiry about well-being / How are you?
signs.hand_configuration: Two-handed knuckles rotation (HOW) followed by single-finger point (YOU)
signs.hand_orientation: Palms rotate from downward to upward, then point forward
signs.movement_sequence: Compound sign: HOW (knuckles rotate) + YOU (index point)
signs.left_hand_sequence: Rotates in unison during HOW, drops to rest during YOU
signs.right_hand_sequence: Rotates during HOW, extends index finger pointing to recipient during YOU
signs.facial_expression: Inquiring head tilt, eyebrows raised (WH-question marker)

signs.hand_configuration: Point to person, index & middle cross on palm (NAME), palms up shake (WHAT)
signs.movement_sequence: Tri-part sequence: YOU -> NAME (finger cross on non-dominant palm) -> WHAT (palms shake)
signs.left_hand_sequence: Provides palm base for NAME tap
signs.right_hand_sequence: Executes point, tap on palm, then outward shake

regional_variant.North: Index finger tapped on opposite palm for NAME
regional_variant.West: Thumb and index form name badge on chest
regional_variant.South: Hand taps chest then horizontal wave for WHAT

signs.hand_configuration: Self point (ME) + open palms like a book (STUDY) + downward person marker
signs.hand_orientation: Palms facing upward like open pages, then facing downward
signs.movement_sequence: Point chest -> Open hands side-by-side -> Drop hands parallel
signs.left_hand_sequence: Book left page motion, parallel person drop
signs.right_hand_sequence: Point chest, book right page motion, parallel person drop

regional_variant.North: Book motion followed by downward person hands
regional_variant.West: Fingers tap forehead then book motion

signs.hand_configuration: Closed fist (dominant) resting on flat open palm (non-dominant)
signs.hand_orientation: Non-dominant palm up, dominant fist knuckle forward
signs.movement_sequence: Fist on flat palm lifted upward together toward chest
signs.left_hand_sequence: Flat open palm supporting right fist, lifts upward
signs.right_hand_sequence: Closed fist resting on left palm, lifts upward
signs.facial_expression: Earnest, pleading, eyebrows raised with concern

regional_variant.North: Fist on flat palm lifted upward together
regional_variant.South: Fist placed on palm twice with earnest gaze

signs.hand_orientation: Back of hand forward, fingertips pointing up
signs.movement_sequence: Index, middle, and ring fingers tap side of chin twice lightly
signs.head_movement: Slight head tilt toward tapping side

regional_variant.North: W-handshape taps side of chin twice
regional_variant.West: Cupped hand miming drinking near mouth
regional_variant.South: Index finger extended tapping near lips

signs.hand_configuration: Dominant hand touches forehead bindi/tilak then opens into national salute
signs.signing_location: Forehead center to front signing space
signs.movement_sequence: Touch forehead center between eyebrows, then open hand outward in graceful wave
signs.right_hand_sequence: Touch tilak position, then expand outward gracefully

regional_variant.National: Tilak forehead touch with open outward flourish

signs.movement_sequence: Fist nods up and down at wrist twice
signs.right_hand_sequence: Wrist flexes down and returns up twice
signs.head_movement: Head nods up and down with fist

signs.hand_configuration: Index and middle fingers snapping against thumb horizontally
signs.movement_sequence: Index and middle fingers snap closed against thumb twice
